hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A combined lending and AMM hook where LPs deposit ETH and TOKEN into a hook-managed full-range V4 position and receive ERC20 shares, while borrowers lock TOKEN as collateral to borrow ETH at 40% LTV with interest. The hook also skims a 0.5% protocol fee from swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and supports permissionless liquidations of underwater positions.
